shortDescription: Manages service-tcp objects on Check Point over Web Services API

options.name: aggressive_aging
options.description: Sets short (aggressive) timeouts for idle connections.

options.name: auto_publish_session
options.description: Publish the current session if changes have been performed after task completes.

options.name: color
options.description: Color of the object. Should be one of existing colors.

options.name: comments
options.description: Comments string.

options.name: details_level
options.description: The level of detail for some of the fields in the response can vary from showing only the UID value of the object to a fully detailed representation of the object.

options.name: groups
options.description: Collection of group identifiers.

options.name: ignore_errors
options.description: Apply changes ignoring errors. You won't be able to publish such a changes. If ignore-warnings flag was omitted - warnings will also be ignored.

options.name: ignore_warnings
options.description: Apply changes ignoring warnings.

options.name: keep_connections_open_after_policy_installation
options.displayName: Keep Connections Open After Policy Installation
options.description: Keep connections open after policy has been installed even if they are not allowed under the new policy. This overrides the settings in the Connection Persistence page. If you change this property, the change will not affect open connections, but only future connections.

options.name: match_by_protocol_signature
options.description: A value of true enables matching by the selected protocol's signature - the signature identifies the protocol as genuine. Select this option to limit the port to the specified protocol. If the selected protocol does not support matching by signature, this field cannot be set to true. Available from R80.10 management version.

options.name: match_for_any
options.description: Indicates whether this service is used when 'Any' is set as the rule's service and there are several service objects with the same source port and protocol.

options.name: name
options.description: Object name.

options.name: override_default_settings
options.description: Indicates whether this service is a Data Domain service which has been overridden. Available from R80.10 management version.

options.name: port
options.description: The number of the port used to provide this service. To specify a port range, place a hyphen between the lowest and highest port numbers, for example 44-55.

options.name: protocol
options.description: Select the protocol type associated with the service, and by implication, the management server (if any) that enforces Content Security and Authentication for the service. Selecting a Protocol Type invokes the specific protocol handlers for each protocol type, thus enabling higher level of security by parsing the protocol, and higher level of connectivity by tracking dynamic actions (such as opening of ports). Available from R80.10 management version.

options.name: session_timeout
options.description: Time (in seconds) before the session times out.

options.name: source_port
options.description: Port number for the client side service. If specified, only those Source port Numbers will be Accepted, Dropped, or Rejected during packet inspection. Otherwise, the source port is not inspected.

options.name: state
options.description: State of the access rule (present or absent).

options.name: sync_connections_on_cluster
options.description: Enables state-synchronized High Availability or Load Sharing on a ClusterXL or OPSEC-certified cluster.

options.name: tags
options.description: Collection of tag identifiers.

options.name: use_default_session_timeout
options.description: Use default virtual session timeout. Available from R80.10 management version.

options.name: version
options.description: Version of checkpoint. If not given one, the latest version taken.

options.name: wait_for_task
options.description: Wait for the task to end. Such as publish task.

options.name: wait_for_task_timeout
options.description: How many minutes to wait until throwing a timeout error.
